description: This file defines the ProvisioningCriteriaData class, which is a data transfer object (DTO) used in the provisioning process within the Fineract system. It contains fields related to provisioning criteria, such as criteria ID, name, associated loan products, definitions, and accounting data, along with static factory methods for creating instances.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaData
classes.description: A data class representing provisioning criteria, including associated loan products, definitions, and GL accounts, with utility methods for instantiation and comparison.

methods.name: toLookup
methods.description: Creates an instance of ProvisioningCriteriaData with specified ID, name, loan products, and definitions, initializing other fields as null.

methods.name: toTemplate
methods.description: Creates a provisioning criteria template with given definitions, loan products, and GL accounts.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Defines comparison logic based on criteria ID for sorting purposes.
